validity_findings: Preflight passed all frozen gates: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 task_success (real scorer, real browser, served page), NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION parseable 0.0/success 0.0, B-RANDOM-ACTION parseable 1.0/task_success 0.2 (<0.6), all five freeze_artifact hashes match, GGUF digests match (3B, 7B shard1, 7B shard2), required stack imports OK. Raw evidence: raw/preflight.json.

Single manipulated variable verified: prompts.system is the ONLY difference between paired treatment/comparator cells. materialized_configs.json confirms diff_confined_to_prompts_system=true for all four cells; treatment overlay sha256 8283aae1... differs from parent only in prompts.system; comparator overlay sha256 a9a6c54f... is byte-identical to parent harness_config.json. No leakage of '#reveal-btn' or 'TARGET-42' in treatment string (sha256 36a4240a...). Raw evidence: raw/materialized_configs.json, provenance.json#prompt_strings.

Positive controls fired as required: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 in all four cells (model_receipts.json per cell); PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight proves the full click-then-answer path is registerable by the frozen scorer. Null control NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION correctly rejects non-JSON (0/5 parseable). Random baseline B-RANDOM-ACTION stays below the 0.6 bar (0.2, matching design-time seed-42 simulation) with parseable 1.0, run against the SERVED page (navigation repaired vs parent's about:blank defect). Raw evidence: raw/controls.json, cells/*/*/raw/model_receipts.json.

Comparator cells are contemporaneous within-run pairs (same model, task, grammar, sampling, seeds, artifacts, code path) and reproduce the frozen parent anchor exactly: task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), answer_action_emission_rate=0.0 (0/5) -> REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT for both M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN. This isolates the treatment effect from run-level environment drift. Raw evidence: cells/*/P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED/raw/model_receipts.json, result.json#controls.B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-7B/3B.

All four model cells are COMPLETE (PC gate 10/10 + exactly 5 episodes), 0 EXCLUDED, 0 PARTIAL. Frozen decision rule precedence applied correctly: rule1_preflight_pass -> rule2a_run_pair (both candidates) -> rule2e_comparator=REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT (both) -> rule2h_treatment_fails_bar (both) -> rule3_falsifies. Raw evidence: raw/decision.json, result.json#metrics.decision_trace.

Treatment prompt supplies the two dimensions audit VF-01 identified as missing from the parent prompt (goal sentence + action schema enumeration) with a single ref->selector alignment to match the frozen GBNF. The failure mode is post-reveal: all 20 episodes show step-0 click succeeds, reveal fires (TARGET-42 visible), then steps 1-4 re-click the hidden button with zero answer actions. This is a planning/state-tracking deficit, not a step-0 discovery failure or parse failure. Raw evidence: cells/*/*/raw/model_receipts.json (all 20 episodes).

Representation loss acknowledged: simplified text DOM (PAGE_TEXT/ELEMENTS/HISTORY) inherited unchanged from parent. After reveal, ELEMENTS is empty and PAGE_TEXT contains TARGET-42, so the re-click loop is not attributable to missing page text. This is a scope limitation, not a confound for the prompt contrast. Raw evidence: prereg.md section 8, parent audit VF-04.

Model provisioning is fail-closed on digest: GGUFs re-downloaded and sha256-verified against frozen parent receipts (raw/gguf_sha256.txt). 7B single-file URL 404 is a documented packaging deviation; same-repo same-model same-quant (Q4_K_M) split shards used. No model or quantization substitution. Raw evidence: preflight.json#gguf_digests, provenance.json#models.
baseline_findings: B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-7B and B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-3B: within-experiment protocol comparators. Both COMPLETE, VALID, REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT (task_success=0.0, parseable_step1=1.0, answer_emission=0.0). Exact replication of frozen parent anchor. Contrast remains identifiable for any treatment positive (not exercised here). Raw evidence: result.json#controls.B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-7B/3B.

PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING: 10/10 per cell (40/40 total). Confirms constrained decoding infrastructure works for both models under both prompt conditions. Raw evidence: cells/*/*/raw/model_receipts.json#positive_control.

claim_ceiling: FALSIFIES at the goal/schema protocol ceiling for the frozen credential-free CPU-quantized Qwen2.5 3B-8B Q4_K_M class under the exact frozen minimal task, harness, grammar, sampling, and seeds. The step-0 reveal-click is NOT converted to a full click-then-answer completion by supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt. Audit VF-01's prompt-underspecification hypothesis is NOT sufficient to explain the parent failure mode at this model class. The bounded negative is scoped to the tested model family, quantization, task, and protocol; it does not close larger models, non-Qwen GGUFs, hosted endpoints, or other domains. C-LLM-INHERIT readiness condition (3) is not satisfied by this model class; the credential-free path remains DESIGN_COMPROMISED.
unresolved: Second-order attribution limit: the treatment bundles (a) goal sentence, (b) action-schema enumeration, (c) grandparent phrasing/wording. This design identifies the bundled 'goal/schema system prompt vs underspecified system prompt' effect (the Director's operational question); it does not decompose goal-only vs schema-only vs phrasing vs generic longer-prompt effects. Per prereg.md section 8 and validity_notes.

Why both models re-emit a click on the now-hidden #reveal-btn across all remaining steps instead of answering, even with the goal sentence and answer action explicitly enumerated, remains an open behavioural question (small-model multi-step planning/state-tracking deficit vs residual prompt/harness effect). Per result.json#unresolved.

Whether larger (14B+) or non-Qwen CPU-quantized GGUFs, or a hosted programmatic endpoint with pinning/SLA, clear the bar under this task is outside the frozen 3B-8B Qwen scope and untested. Per prereg.md section 8 and result.json#unresolved.
H1b (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED) was not exercised because no treatment cell cleared; a positive prompt effect remains unmeasured by this packet. Per result.json#unresolved.

The deterministic protocol (temperature=0.0, fixed seeds) produces zero within-cell variance; the 3/5 rule is an adequacy rule for a capability gate, not a statistical threshold. No variance estimate or p-value is possible. Per prereg.md section 8 and validity_notes.
